prompts.leaf: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: editorial photograph for The Kleronomia Society, an intellectual journal and philosophical society. A real-world, extremely close, intimate photographic study: recognizable subject, deliberately decontextualized by tight cropping and very shallow depth of field. Natural optical falloff, a narrow plane of crisp detail and generous organic bokeh; no fake tilt-shift. Tactile, imperfect physical texture. Quiet, humane, observant mood. Soft natural directional light, restrained warm ivory, muted olive, ochre and deep ink tones appropriate to an elegant printed journal. Subtle 35mm film grain, believable color, gentle highlights, rich but open shadows. Sophisticated, unposed editorial photography, not advertising or clinical stock. No text, lettering, logos, watermark, border, collage, robots, screens, circuitry, neon, CGI gloss, oversharpening, excessive orange grading or fantasy effects. Subject: a single freshly unfurling beech leaf on a slender living twig, photographed extremely close at the first light of spring. The delicate translucent folded leaf and fine vein network are tack sharp along one diagonal fold, pale olive gold at the rim; neighboring leaf edges dissolve into warm woodland bokeh. The twig leaves the frame. The subject fills the crop, a tangible living form becoming almost abstract while remaining unmistakably a new leaf. No full tree, no landscape, no dew gimmicks. Portrait composition, approximately 4:5, sufficient fine detail for a large website hero. The leaf should sit near the middle with room for a small amount of natural crop.
